regime_context: The policy regime is a sequenced credibility-banking setup: Treasury suppresses front-end yields structurally while the Fed under Warsh holds hawkish optionality; the consensus 'coordinated easing' read diverges from revealed preference because the administration wants lower real yields without validating inflation through near-term cuts.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是一种分阶段的可信度储备布局：财政部长端结构性压低前端收益率，而Warsh领导下的美联储保持鹰派选项；市场“协同宽松”的共识与显示性偏好背离，因为政府想要更低的实际收益率，但不愿以近期降息来验证通胀。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh's Fed is banking hawkish credibility and has not conceded cuts; sticky inflation and a hawkish rates path leave long-duration Treasuries exposed, while Treasury's bill-heavy issuance does not suppress the back end. Until a labor crack forces a data-driven pivot, TLT is duration risk against SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: Warsh领导下的美联储正在储备鹰派信誉且尚未让步降息；粘性通胀和偏鹰的利率路径使长久期美债承压，而财政部以短债为主的发行并未压低长端。在就业裂口推动数据驱动的转向之前，TLT相对SPY是久期风险来源。
evidence: Open prediction: Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026 meetings (hold or hike)
May PCE ran hot (core +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y); Warsh held hawkish Sintra line
CME FedWatch moved to >70% probability of a Sept hike
Quad is Reflation with growth score -0.133 and inflation score 0.08
theses.dissent: A widening labor crack could force a data-driven September pivot, and any flight-to-quality bid from Iran escalation would lift long Treasuries.
theses.dissent_zh: 就业裂口扩大可能迫使美联储转向数据驱动的9月宽松，同时伊朗升级引发的避险买盘会推升长期美债。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date.
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日期之前，TLT跑赢SPY达到5%。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: Iran/Middle East re-escalation has re-primed oil upside, and the Q1 2026 energy inflow rotation was already conflict-driven; Trump's strike cadence keeps a headline premium in energy relative to SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗/中东局势再升级重新点燃油价上行，而2026年一季度的能源资金流入本已由冲突驱动；特朗普的打击频率使能源股相对SPY保持头条溢价。
evidence: Iran ceasefire collapse over 7/8; US strikes 7/8–11; Brent spiked ~$80 intraday
Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026 on the conflict
theses.dissent: Any durable ceasefire or de-escalation would cap oil and reverse the headline bid; weak growth also drags energy demand.
theses.dissent_zh: 任何持续的停火或降级都会限制油价并逆转头条买盘；经济增长疲弱也会拖累能源需求。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date.
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日期之前，XLE跑输SPY达到5%。

theses.subject: XLF
theses.thesis: Bessent's dealer-intermediation reform, central-clearing expansion, eSLR progress, and Fed MBS runoff into T-bills tilt the plumbing toward dealer banks; the front-end bill regime and higher rates support financials relative to SPY, even if a hike cycle raises credit risk.
theses.thesis_zh: Bessent的交易商中介改革、中央清算扩容、eSLR进展，以及美联储将MBS缩表再投资于短债，都使管道向交易商银行倾斜；前端短债体制和更高利率支撑金融股相对SPY，尽管加息周期会抬高信用风险。
evidence: Open prediction: Concrete eSLR-reform progress from a banking regulator
Open prediction: SEC advances Treasury central-clearing expansion
Open prediction: Fed keeps reinvesting MBS runoff into T-bills through 2026
Rotation targeted: Financials / dealer banks (XLF, KBE)
theses.dissent: A hawkish September hike with weak growth could widen credit concerns and compress net interest margins, making financials a value trap relative to SPY.
theses.dissent_zh: 9月加息叠加增长疲弱可能扩大信用担忧并压缩净息差，使金融股相对SPY成为价值陷阱。

falsifier.text: XLF lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date.
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日期之前，XLF跑输SPY达到5%。

theses.subject: SMR
theses.thesis: The DOE's planned HALEU release into the fuel bank and the nuclear-for-AI policy lever act as direct supply/backstop for advanced nuclear; power/grid/datacenter capex supports the SMR complex relative to SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: 美国能源部计划向燃料库释放HALEU，以及AI核能政策杠杆，对先进核能构成直接供应/托底；电力/电网/数据中心资本开支支撑SMR主题相对SPY。
evidence: Open prediction: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU into the fuel bank for private/AI projects
Rotation targeted: Nuclear · uranium · HALEU/fuel cycle
Rotation targeted: Power · grid · datacenter capex (AI compute)
theses.dissent: Hawkish financing conditions hurt long-duration capex, and advanced nuclear names can de-rate on delays or cost overruns; a critical-minerals truce does not guarantee reactor orders.
theses.dissent_zh: 鹰派融资环境会伤害长周期资本开支，先进核能公司可能因延期或成本超支而估值下修；关键矿产停火并不保证反应堆订单。

falsifier.text: SMR lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date.
falsifier.text_zh: 在核查日期之前，SMR跑输SPY达到5%。
